notes: Three routes meet at قتادة: he is named before the first «ح» and once after the last one («كلاهما عن قتادة»), so he is read once as the shared tail
«قال لي أبي» gives Mu'tamir's father by relation alone (`relation`)
«وفي حديث التيمي» names another transmitter for the same saying: a `variant` group, not a route; «وفي حديث شيبان وأبي عوانة» is wording only and is left out
«بإسناد شعبة» points to another chain and is not a link; «قال فسرها قتادة» is commentary, not a link
